cat > /etc/systemd/system/l2-bridge.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Join eth1/eth2 into a transparent L2 bridge (br0)
After=network.target interfaces-config.service
Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/sh -c 'ip link del br0 2>/dev/null; ip link add name br0 type bridge stp_state 0; ip link set eth1 master br0; ip link set eth2 master br0; ip link set eth1 up; ip link set eth2 up; ip link set br0 up'
ExecStop=/usr/bin/sh -c 'ip link set eth1 nomaster; ip link set eth2 nomaster; ip link del br0'

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable l2-bridge.service; systemctl stop interfaces-config.service; systemctl disable interfaces-config.service 2>&1 | tail -5
